title: SWTOR5CombatGridSystem
description: Data contracts for the tactical grid combat system in star-wars-rpg.jsx. Grid dimensions: GW=8 cols, GH=6 rows. All coordinates are row/col (not x/y).

AIProfile.description: Shape of entries in AI_COMBAT_PROFILES constant (line ~6302). All sliders are raw integers, not normalised.

aggression.description: Chance-weight for closing distance each AI turn.

cover.description: Preference multiplier for high-cover destination cells.

flank.description: Bonus score applied when a candidate move achieves flanking angle.

overwatch.description: Percent chance per turn that the AI takes overwatch instead of moving.

optRange.description: Chebyshev distance the AI tries to maintain from the player.

name.description: Display name shown in the combat HUD and log.

hp.description: Starting hit points for this opponent profile.

shield.description: Starting shield points. Shield absorbs damage before HP.

accent.description: Hex colour used for the enemy glyph and HP bar.

InteractiveObject.description: Element of the 'objs' array inside CombatState. Created by genCombatMap().

type.description: barrel: explosive on proximity hit. steam: generates concealment cloud. turret: hackable with Glitch gadget.

active.description: False once a barrel has detonated.

hacked.description: Turret only. When true the turret fires on the enemy each enemy turn.

GadgetInventory.description: Charge counts for the four player gadget types.

thermal.description: Thermal Detonator. Costs 2 AP. Area damage 5, destroys cover in blast radius.

flash.description: Flashbang. Costs 1 AP. Blinds enemy for 2 turns (35% hit chance penalty).

shield.description: Shield Emitter. Costs 2 AP. Restores +4 player shield.

glitch.description: Cyber-Glitch. Costs 1 AP. Hacks nearest turret within 2 squares of enemy.

LootItem.description: Item dropped on a successful engagement outcome. Follows the ITEMS constant schema.

Loot.description: Payload passed to onSuccess when the player wins. Produced by rollLoot().

CombatState.description: Complete gs state object inside TacticalGridCombatOverlay. Updated via upd(patch).

ap.description: Action points remaining this player turn. Resets to 3 at start of each turn.

pOW.description: Player overwatch active. Triggers reaction fire when enemy moves into LoS.

eBlind.description: Turns remaining that enemy is blinded (hit chance 35% of normal).

log.description: Combat event log. Displayed as last 4 entries. Capped by .slice(-4).

cover.description: GH-length array of GW-length rows. Value 0=open, 1=half cover (-25% hit to occupant not flanked), 2=full cover (-50% hit).

steam.description: Sparse map of 'row,col' string keys to integer turn-counts. A cell with a key here is concealed (breaks LoS). Value decrements each enemy turn; removed when it reaches 1.

MinigameDispatchPayload.description: Object passed to setActiveMinigame() from world object interactions. The 'type' field selects which overlay renders.

onSuccess.description: Callback function reference. Called with loot payload for tactical_combat wins.

flavorText.description: tactical_combat only. Intro screen narrative text.

difficulty.description: terminal_slicing only. Controls node count (difficulty + 3 nodes).

SliceNode.description: A node in the TerminalSlicingOverlay canvas graph.

EncounterTableEntry.description: Entry in ENCOUNTER_TABLE. Maps zone IDs to arrays of profile keys.

description: Top-level wrapper. In practice each piece lives as a constant or state slice, not as one object.

AI_COMBAT_PROFILES.description: Keyed by profile ID string (e.g. 'syndicate_thug'). Values follow AIProfile schema.
